item.title: Confidence in Labour Crashes to Record Low as Cost of Living Bites
item.description: Household finances are under intense pressure as a new poll shows public confidence in Labour’s handling of the cost of living has hit a record low, with rising energy bills and food prices driving growing concern across Scotland and beyond.The post Confidence in Labour Crashes to Record Low as Cost of Living Bites appeared first on The Highland Times.

item.title: Dingwall Locals Get Creative Ahead of Bright Burgh Trail
item.description: Dingwall residents are lighting up the town this January as part of the Bright Burgh Trail, launching a year-long celebration of Dingwall 800 with illuminated windows, community art and a magical evening walk through the Royal Burgh.The post Dingwall Locals Get Creative Ahead of Bright Burgh Trail appeared first on The Highland Times.

item.title: Inverness Councillors Move Closer to Short Term Let Control Areas
item.description: Inverness councillors have agreed to progress plans to consult on two Short Term Let Control Areas covering the city and surrounding rural communities, allowing public feedback on housing pressures linked to holiday lets.The post Inverness Councillors Move Closer to Short Term Let Control Areas appeared first on The Highland Times.

item.title: Recovery Continues Across Highlands After Days of Severe Snow
item.description: Recovery is continuing across the Highlands as roads, ferries and airports return to normal after days of severe snow, with local road and rail impacts still being cleared and cold conditions expected to linger into the weekend.The post Recovery Continues Across Highlands After Days of Severe Snow appeared first on The Highland Times.

item.title: Fresh Snow and Ice Warnings Issued for Highlands & Islands as Cold Snap Continues
item.description: Fresh snow and ice warnings have been issued for the Highlands and Islands as freezing conditions persist, with disruption expected on roads and transport, higher snowfall on hills, and widespread ice posing risks to communities through the weekend.The post Fresh Snow and Ice Warnings Issued for Highlands & Islands as Cold Snap Continues appeared first on The Highland Times.

item.title: Sharp Rise in A9 Closures Fuels Concern Over Fragile Transport Links in The Far North
item.description: A Freedom of Information request has revealed a sharp rise in A9 closures over the past decade, fuelling concern among far north communities who say the vital route is increasingly fragile, with disruption affecting daily life across Caithness, Sutherland and Ross.The post Sharp Rise in A9 Closures Fuels Concern Over Fragile Transport Links in The Far North appeared first on The Highland Times.

item.title: FLS Urges Extra Caution as Winter Freeze Continues Across Northern Scotland
item.description: Forestry and Land Scotland is urging extra caution in woodlands across northern Scotland as freezing conditions persist, warning that icy trails, damaged trees and limited site inspections mean visitors should take care during winter walks.The post FLS Urges Extra Caution as Winter Freeze Continues Across Northern Scotland appeared first on The Highland Times.

item.title: White House Accused of ‘Gangsterism at Home and Piracy at Sea’
item.description: The Scottish Greens have condemned the use of Wick Airport in US military operations, accusing the Trump administration of lawless foreign policy and urging clear assurances that Scotland’s infrastructure will not be used in future overseas actions.The post White House Accused of ‘Gangsterism at Home and Piracy at Sea’ appeared first on The Highland Times.

item.title: How Work is Being Found Across The Highlands is Quietly Changing
item.description: Work across the Highlands is being found in a new way, with jobs now sitting inside trusted local spaces people already use every day. The Highland Times network is quietly reshaping how employers and jobseekers connect.The post How Work is Being Found Across The Highlands is Quietly Changing appeared first on The Highland Times.

item.title: Starmer’s Cost-of-Living Failure Blamed as Retail Footfall Slumps in December
item.description: Retail footfall fell sharply across Scotland in December as households cut back amid rising bills and food costs, with new figures and polling fuelling criticism of Labour’s handling of the cost-of-living crisis and its impact on local businesses.The post Starmer’s Cost-of-Living Failure Blamed as Retail Footfall Slumps in December appeared first on The Highland Times.
